name: JJK Gauntlet Database
scope: Original Jujutsu Kaisen manga, ch. 1-271. Peak versions only. JJK Modulo excluded.

canon_status_legend.fanbook: Named in official supplementary material, not shown in fights

characters.name: Yuji Itadori

domain.name: Unnamed (his hometown)
domain.sure_hit: Soul Dismantle on the boundary between souls

characters.story_hook: Hits the soul, not just the body. Gets stronger the longer the fight goes.
characters.notes: JJK Modulo Yuji is far stronger; excluded to keep the original-manga peak.

characters.name: Megumi Fushiguro
techniques: Ten Shadows (Divine Dogs, Nue, Max Elephant, Toad, Great Serpent, Rabbit Escape)

special.description: When Megumi would fall, 40% chance he summons Mahoraga: the opponent loses 15 power for this round. Megumi still falls.

characters.story_hook: Calm tactician with a dog pack and one very bad last-resort summon.

characters.name: Nobara Kugisaki
techniques: Resonance (damage through an effigy or a severed body part)
characters.story_hook: Nails, a hammer, and zero fear. Resonance hurts the soul from a distance.

characters.name: Maki Zenin
characters.peak_version: Complete Heavenly Restriction (after the Zenin Clan massacre)
characters.story_hook: No cursed energy at all, so closed domains can't target her. Pure speed and steel.

characters.name: Panda

special.description: The first time Panda would fall, he switches cores and stays in (once per run).

characters.story_hook: Three souls in one body. Hard to put down for good.

characters.name: Toge Inumaki
techniques: Cursed Speech (stop, blast away, don't move, etc.)

special.description: vs opponents 10+ power above him: +3 and double fall risk. Otherwise +6.

characters.story_hook: Only speaks in rice-ball ingredients. When he says a real word, things obey.

characters.name: Yuta Okkotsu
characters.peak_version: Shinjuku Showdown (Rika, Authentic Mutual Love, Gojo's body)
techniques: Copied: Cursed Speech, Uro's Thin Ice Breaker, Charles' G Warstaff
Brain-hop into Gojo's body: Unlimited Void, Hollow Purple

domain.name: Authentic Mutual Love
domain.sure_hit: One copied technique at a time, stored in katanas

special.description: Before each round, copies one copyable counter tag from the opponent.

characters.story_hook: Endless cursed energy and a borrowed toolbox. Will become a monster if it wins.

characters.name: Kinji Hakari
techniques: Jackpot: unlimited cursed energy + automatic RCT for 4m11s

domain.name: Idle Death Gamble
domain.sure_hit: Forces a pachinko game; no direct damage

special.description: 25% per round: Hakari can't fall this round and the team gets +5.

characters.story_hook: A gambler whose domain is a pachinko machine. Hit the jackpot and he's unkillable.

characters.name: Kirara Hoshi
characters.story_hook: Controls who can get close to whom. Hakari's partner in crime.

characters.name: Aoi Todo

special.description: Team gets +3 while at least 2 members are alive.

characters.story_hook: Yuji's self-declared best friend. One clap and the whole fight rearranges.

characters.name: Noritoshi Kamo
techniques: Blood Manipulation: Flowing Red Scale, Piercing Blood, Convergence
characters.story_hook: Kamo clan heir. Precise blood techniques from a bag of blood packs.

characters.name: Kokichi Muta (Mechamaru)
characters.story_hook: A frail body traded for a huge cursed energy tank, poured into a giant robot.

characters.name: Kasumi Miwa
characters.story_hook: Self-described useless Miwa. Her Simple Domain says otherwise.

characters.name: Momo Nishimiya
characters.story_hook: Scouts from the sky and calls the plays.

characters.name: Mai Zenin
techniques: Construction (one bullet at a time, costly)
characters.story_hook: Maki's twin. One perfect shot when it matters.

characters.name: Kento Nanami
characters.story_hook: A salaryman sorcerer. Clocks out at a certain hour, then gets dangerous.

characters.name: Mei Mei

special.description: Once per run: +8 on the round the team needs it most.

characters.story_hook: Mercenary with an axe and a crow army. Charges for everything.

characters.name: Atsuya Kusakabe
characters.story_hook: No cursed technique, just elite sword work and the best Simple Domain around.

characters.name: Naobito Zenin
characters.story_hook: Head of the Zenin clan and once the fastest sorcerer alive. Drinks on the job.

characters.name: Masamichi Yaga
characters.story_hook: Principal and puppet-maker. Knits while he thinks.

characters.name: Takuma Ino
techniques: Auspicious Beasts: Kaichi, Reiki, Kirin, Baku
characters.story_hook: Nanami's admirer. Summons lucky beasts through a mask.

characters.name: Yuki Tsukumo

special.description: Once per run on a losing round: +10, then Yuki falls after the round.

characters.story_hook: Special grade who asks everyone their type. Her last move collapses into a black hole.

characters.name: Hiromi Higuruma

domain.name: Deadly Sentencing
domain.sure_hit: Forces a trial; verdict can confiscate a technique or grant the Executioner's Sword

characters.story_hook: A lawyer who awakened in weeks. Puts opponents on trial; a guilty verdict can mean a sure-kill sword.
characters.notes: Confiscation takes a cursed tool first if the target holds one (Sukuna lost Kamutoke, ch. 245).

characters.name: Hajime Kashimo

special.description: First losing round: +12, then Kashimo falls after the round.

characters.story_hook: A 400-year-old lightning sorcerer looking for someone strong enough. His trump card burns his body out.
characters.notes: Gray character (Culling Game player). Locked to heroes: he fought for Jujutsu High in Shinjuku.

characters.name: Fumihiko Takaba
techniques: Comedian (whatever he finds funny becomes real)

special.description: The first time any teammate would fall, it doesn't happen (once per run).

characters.story_hook: A struggling comedian whose jokes rewrite reality. As long as he finds it funny, he can't lose.

characters.name: Hana Kurusu (Angel)
characters.story_hook: Shares her body with a Heian sorcerer whose light erases techniques, barriers, and cursed objects.

characters.name: Choso
techniques: Blood Manipulation: Convergence, Piercing Blood, Supernova, Flowing Red Scale
characters.story_hook: Eldest Death Painting brother. Now Yuji's big brother, and he means it.
characters.notes: Gray character. Locked to heroes (sided with Yuji after Shibuya).

characters.name: Satoru Gojo
techniques: Limitless: Infinity, Blue, Red, Hollow Purple (200%)

domain.name: Unlimited Void
domain.sure_hit: Floods the target with infinite information

characters.story_hook: The Strongest. Untouchable until someone finds a way around Infinity.
characters.notes: Final boss of the Villain Gauntlet. Legendary draft roll in the Hero Gauntlet.

characters.name: Ryomen Sukuna
techniques: Ten Shadows via Megumi's body, incl. Mahoraga

domain.name: Malevolent Shrine
domain.sure_hit: Dismantle and Cleave on everything in range

characters.story_hook: The King of Curses. Treats every fight as a meal.
characters.notes: Final boss of the Hero Gauntlet. Legendary draft roll in the Villain Gauntlet.

characters.name: Kenjaku
characters.peak_version: Culling Game / vs Yuki and Choso
characters.story_hook: A thousand-year schemer wearing Geto's face. Always three moves ahead.

characters.name: Suguru Geto
characters.peak_version: Night Parade of a Hundred Demons (JJK 0)
characters.story_hook: Gojo's former best friend. Commands an army of swallowed curses.

characters.name: Toji Fushiguro
characters.story_hook: The Sorcerer Killer. Invisible to cursed energy and carrying a blade that cancels techniques.

characters.name: Miguel Oduol
characters.story_hook: Geto's loyal ally. His Black Rope kept even Gojo busy.

characters.name: Naoya Zenin (Cursed Spirit)

domain.name: Time Cell Moon Palace
domain.sure_hit: Projection Sorcery applied to the target's cells

characters.story_hook: Came back as a curse just to get revenge. Faster than sound.
characters.notes: His domain failed to target Maki because she has zero cursed energy (canon).

characters.name: Ogi Zenin
characters.story_hook: Maki and Mai's father. Head of the Zenin's military arm, and cruel about it.

characters.name: Mahito
characters.peak_version: Shibuya (Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing)
techniques: Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing

special.description: Once per run, Mahito reshapes himself instead of falling.

characters.story_hook: A curse born from human hatred. Reshapes souls like clay, and enjoys it.

characters.name: Jogo
characters.story_hook: A volcano-headed curse who believes curses are the true humans.

characters.name: Hanami
characters.story_hook: A calm nature curse who wants to protect the planet from humans.

characters.name: Dagon
characters.story_hook: A sea curse whose domain is a beach that never ends.

characters.name: Kurourushi
characters.story_hook: A special-grade cockroach curse. Nobody wants this fight.

characters.name: Uraume
characters.story_hook: Sukuna's cook and most loyal servant from the Heian era.

characters.name: Eso
characters.story_hook: Middle Death Painting brother. Blood that rots.

characters.name: Kechizu
characters.story_hook: Youngest Death Painting brother. Loud, weird, loyal.

characters.name: Yorozu

domain.name: Threefold Affliction
domain.sure_hit: True Sphere as a guaranteed hit

special.description: Once per run on a losing round: +10.

characters.story_hook: A Heian sorcerer obsessed with Sukuna. Her perfect sphere carries infinite pressure.

characters.name: Ryu Ishigori
characters.story_hook: Edo-era sorcerer with the biggest cursed energy output of his time. Talks in food metaphors.
characters.notes: Gray: a Culling Game player, not a schemer. Locked to villains.

characters.name: Takako Uro

special.description: Once per run, cancels the opponent's counter bonus for one round.

characters.story_hook: Heian assassin captain who treats the sky like fabric.
characters.notes: Gray: Culling Game player. Locked to villains.

characters.name: Reggie Star
characters.story_hook: Turns receipts into whatever he bought. Surprisingly nasty.

characters.name: Haruta Shigemo

special.description: 15% chance to avoid falling each time.

characters.story_hook: Somehow keeps surviving. The meme pick.

counters.explanation: Yuji can hit Mahito's real soul (Shibuya).
Nobara's Resonance reached Mahito's true body through a clone.
Yuji's soul Dismantle targets the boundary between souls (ch. 264-268).
Nobara hit Sukuna through his last finger (ch. 267). Requires a body part.
Resonance bypassing Infinity is fan speculation, never shown.
Inverted Spear of Heaven cut through Infinity (2006).
World-Cutting Slash cuts space itself and ended the Gojo fight.
Mahoraga adapted to Infinity and showed Sukuna the way through.
Domain Amplification neutralizes Infinity on contact.
Black Rope unravels techniques; Miguel survived fighting Gojo.
Jacob's Ladder nearly purged Sukuna from Megumi (ch. 213).
Any curse bathed in Jacob's Ladder is extinguished.
Technique Extinguishment erases techniques and barriers.
Confiscation strips a technique-reliant fighter's technique.
Confiscation takes a cursed tool first (Sukuna lost Kamutoke, ch. 245).
Executioner's Sword is a sure-kill; Sukuna had to cut off his own hand (ch. 247).
Same sword, applied to other guilty villains.
Toji ambushed Gojo because he's invisible to cursed energy sensing.
Geto/Kenjaku absorb defeated curses (Kenjaku took Mahito).
Takaba stalled Kenjaku long enough for Yuta's ambush (ch. 243). Grants a free stall, see special.
Cursed Speech on a zero-CE target is a popular theory, never shown.
Elemental flavor only.
Elemental flavor only.

domain_rules.text: If the opponent has a sure-hit domain and the defending side has no domain, anti-domain, or zero-CE fighter, the opponent gains DOM/10.
Simple Domain / Hollow Wicker Basket users cut that bonus in half. Kusakabe (strong_anti_domain) cancels it fully.
Zero-CE fighters cancel the bonus from CLOSED domains (Maki vs Naoya's Time Cell Moon Palace).
Open domains (Sukuna, Kenjaku) still hit zero-CE fighters; Malevolent Shrine cuts everything in range.
If both sides have sure-hit domains, the higher DOM side gets +2 (domain refinement decides clashes).

rules.team_formula: top_power + others_coef * sum(other_power * gap_factor) + synergy + counters + domain + specials + rng
rules.fall_weight: (110 - power), halved for rct, x special fall_weight
rules.ai_role: Narrates the result it is given. Never decides outcomes.

progression.note: Mastery levels 1-10 per character, earned from runs. Unlocks card frames and titles only, never power, so daily runs stay fair.
